Question: Let \(C_1\) and \(C_2\) be circles defined by \[(x - 10)^2 + y^2 = 36\] and \[(x + 15)^2 + y^2 = 81,\] respectively. What is the length of the shortest line segment \(\overline{PQ}\) that is tangent to \(C_1\) at \(P\) and to \(C_2\) at \(Q?\)
